body.name: quadratic regret multiplier process
body.construction: Take the optimizer coordinates of \(G_n^*\), evaluate \(Q_n^*(c)=\tfrac12G^*_{n,\theta}(c)^\top\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}}G^*_{n,\theta}(c)\), and use a shared conditional quantile of any prespecified continuous supremum functional of \(Q_n^*\).
